Context: FREQUENT.LY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENT.LY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. What is the maximum number of unavailed Joining Time that can be credited to the EL account of a Government servant who has 295 days at credit? 5 days.
2. Can the benefit of increment be granted during Joining Time? No, it will be granted only after he joins duty.
3. Can Joining Time be combined with Casual Leave ? No.
